item.title: [github_trending] google/ax
item.description: AX is Google's open-source declarative orchestrator for agent workloads: you define Workspaces and Tasks in YAML, and it sandboxes them, fences their network, and schedules them across a cluster on top of Agent Substrate, with the project claiming billions of tasks per cluster. Its Kubernetes-like workflow should appeal to teams running autonomous agents in bulk, though the core concepts and protocols are still evolving and breaking changes are expected before a stable release.

item.title: [infoq] 《2026年中国人工智能计算力发展评估报告》发布，智能体重塑算力基础设施，智能算力规模预计增长87.9%

item.description: InfoQ summarises the 15 finalists of GOAI's "boundless applications" track, spanning commercial spaceflight, manufacturing supply chains, travel planning, agricultural insurance and investment research, including projects such as 质链 Agent, RoadMan, 穹野智保 and HunterCode. It argues AI apps are moving from merely having features to actually completing tasks, with models sharing work with deterministic rules, tools, data and human approval to form end-to-end delivery chains.

item.title: [infoq] 70强项目观察之新智基座：Agent正在从“会聊”走向“会干活”
item.description: InfoQ analyses the 15 finalists of GOAI's "Agent Infra" track, arguing the competition is shifting from model capability to system capability, with permission isolation, evidence chains, human gates, state read-back and rollback becoming shared engineering problems. Using projects such as DataFlow-Agent, CodeNotary, CyberGuard and RepoMesh, it says agents are moving from generating answers to delivering results, and multi-agent setups from role-play to shared responsibility.

item.title: [infoq] Lambda SnapStart 现已支持容器镜像
item.description: AWS has extended Lambda SnapStart to functions packaged as container images; it previously covered only managed runtimes for Python, .NET and Java. SnapStart snapshots an initialized execution environment at deploy time and restores from it on invoke, and AWS says starts now take under a second. Since container images allow up to 10 GB versus 250 MB for ZIPs, teams that moved to containers for size no longer have to give up fast cold starts.

item.title: [infoq] NVIDIA Personal AI Router 将 AI 任务分配到本地计算资源上
item.description: NVIDIA has released a beta of Personal AI Router (PAIR), which pools inference capacity from multiple machines on a local network and dispatches each request to a compatible node, integrating with Ollama and LM Studio without changes to agent frameworks. Aimed at local multi-agent workloads, its demo combining RTX Spark, DGX Spark and an RTX 5090 cut runtime to roughly half that of a single laptop, though NVIDIA stresses this is no performance guarantee and PAIR does not merge GPUs or VRAM.

item.title: [infoq] 复杂业务 Agent 的持续进化：快手电商导购的 Harness Loop 实践｜QCon上海
item.description: At QCon Shanghai, Bao Lei, who heads Kuaishou e-commerce's AI platform engineering team, will present the Harness Loop behind Kuaishou's shopping-guide agent. That agent spans search and recommendation, promotions, fulfillment and after-sales, and is built on a unified tool protocol, dynamic context management and cross-domain tool orchestration. His takeaway: shipping complex agents depends less on model capability than on an orchestrateable, observable and evaluable Harness engineering system.

item.title: [github_trending] mvt-project/mvt
item.description: MVT (Mobile Verification Toolkit) is a Python collection of utilities from Amnesty International Security Lab, first released in July 2021 as part of the Pegasus Project, for gathering forensic traces on Android and iOS devices to spot signs of compromise. The project recently merged a v3 branch that introduces breaking changes, so scripts consuming MVT output may need updates. Aimed at forensic analysts and security researchers.

item.title: [github_trending] anthropics/financial-services
item.description: anthropics/financial-services is Anthropic's reference collection of agents, skills and data connectors for investment banking, equity research, private equity and wealth management. The same system prompt and skills run either as a Claude Cowork plugin or through the Claude Managed Agents API. Agents like Pitch Agent and GL Reconciler only draft models, memos and reconciliations; the repo stresses this is not investment advice and every output needs human sign-off.

item.description: A Juejin post imagines what technical interviews look like now that AI coding is everywhere, mocking up a hypothetical Android engineer interview for a candidate named Xiaoming and asking whether the same old questions still get asked. item.title: [github_trending] agent-substrate/substrate
item.description: Agent Substrate is a secure-by-default execution runtime for autonomous agents that multiplexes many mostly-idle actors onto a small pool of workers. Its README claims 10x the sandbox density of standard container runtimes, sub-500ms resumes, over 500 suspend/resume activations per second, zero-trust kernel and network isolation, and support for microVMs and gVisor under one lifecycle API. It ships under Apache 2.0 and is not an officially supported Google product.

item.title: [github_trending] dream-num/univer
item.description: Univer is an Office SDK aimed at AI agents, bundling spreadsheets, documents, presentations, canvas, relational tables and soon PDF into a single runtime. It offers a plugin architecture, Canvas-based rendering, a formula engine, and one Facade API that runs both in the browser and on Node.js. Developers embedding spreadsheet or document features into their own products are the intended users.

item.title: [github_trending] superdesigndev/treg
item.description: Treg positions itself as OpenRouter for agent tools: one base URL and one token reach 3,000+ catalogued endpoints across 60+ providers, spanning SEO and backlinks, social trends, people and company enrichment, ads, scraping and image or video generation, priced per call from a cent with no provider signup. It also exposes a team's own keys, skills and CLIs to every teammate's agent without credentials leaving the server, and it is self-hostable.

item.title: [github_trending] browser-use/video-use
item.description: video-use is a 100% open-source tool that edits videos through Claude Code: drop raw footage into a folder, chat with the agent, and get a final.mp4. It cuts filler words and dead space, auto color grades segments, applies 30ms audio fades, burns subtitles, and can spawn parallel sub-agents to generate animation overlays via HyperFrames, Remotion, Manim, or PIL. It also self-evaluates every rendered cut, making it useful for creators who prefer coding-agent workflows over traditional video edito

item.title: [github_trending] davila7/claude-code-templates
item.description: claude-code-templates is a CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code, published as the same-named npm package under the MIT license. The README is mostly badges — npm version, download counts, sponsors — so concrete functionality has to come from the CLI itself after install. It targets developers who want reusable, templated Claude Code setups.
